mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_voucher (voucher_id, voucher_no, pay_date, summary_note, approved_yn) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER.NEXTVAL, NULL, LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')), #{token}, 'N' FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pay_voucher v WHERE v.summary_note = #{token} )

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 - 1 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'D', b.dept_id, b.pay_sum, 0 FROM ( SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS pay_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) b

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.dept_id) * 2 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'C', b.dept_id, 0, b.ded_sum FROM ( SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(dd.amount), 0) AS ded_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id /* 세금만 반영하려면: AND dd.deduction_code LIKE 'T%' / 税金だけを反映する場合 */ WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) b

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY x.dept_id) + 1000 AS line_seq, -- 충돌 방지 오프셋 / 衝突回避のオフセット #{accountId}, 'C', x.dept_id, 0, GREATEST(x.net_sum, 0) FROM ( WITH i AS ( -- 지급합계(부서별) / 支給合計（部署別） SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(i.amount),0) AS pay_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ), d AS ( -- 공제합계(부서별) / 控除合計（部署別） SELECT e.dept_id, NVL(SUM(dd.amount),0) AS ded_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) SELECT COALESCE(i.dept_id, d.dept_id) AS dept_id, NVL(i.pay_sum,0) - NVL(d.ded_sum,0) AS net_sum FROM i FULL OUTER JOIN d ON d.dept_id = i.dept_id ) x

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.dept_id) * 2 - 1 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'D', n.dept_id, GREATEST(n.net_sum, 0), 0 FROM ( WITH i AS ( SELECT p.payslip_id, SUM(i.amount) pay_sum FROM payslip p LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY p.payslip_id ), d AS ( SELECT p.payslip_id, SUM(dd.amount) ded_sum FROM payslip p LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY p.payslip_id ) SELECT e.dept_id, SUM(NVL(p.net_pay_amt, NVL(i.pay_sum,0) - NVL(d.ded_sum,0))) AS net_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id LEFT JOIN d ON d.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) n

INSERT INTO pay_voucher_line (line_id, voucher_id, line_seq, account_id, drcr_code, dept_id, debit_amt, credit_amt) SELECT SEQ_PAY_VOUCHER_LINE.NEXTVAL, #{voucherId}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.dept_id) * 2 AS line_seq, #{accountId}, 'C', n.dept_id, 0, GREATEST(n.net_sum, 0) FROM ( WITH i AS ( SELECT p.payslip_id, SUM(i.amount) pay_sum FROM payslip p LEFT JOIN payslip_item i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY p.payslip_id ), d AS ( SELECT p.payslip_id, SUM(dd.amount) ded_sum FROM payslip p LEFT JOIN payslip_deduction dd ON dd.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY p.payslip_id ) SELECT e.dept_id, SUM(NVL(p.net_pay_amt, NVL(i.pay_sum,0) - NVL(d.ded_sum,0))) AS net_sum FROM payslip p JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = p.emp_id LEFT JOIN i ON i.payslip_id = p.payslip_id LEFT JOIN d ON d.payslip_id = p.payslip_id WHERE p.apply_yyyymm = #{yyyymm} AND p.pay_type = #{payType} GROUP BY e.dept_id ) n
